explication: This repository is a multi-product .NET GraphQL platform. Its central documented workflow is a client request handled by Hot Chocolate, with data shaping and paging applied to queryable sources; GreenDonut provides batching and caching for resolver data access. The tree also shows MCP and OpenAPI adapters and CookieCrumble snapshot-testing support. Some subsystems are represented only by paths, so their internal wiring is omitted rather than inferred.
